<div class="backup-code" style="--slidev-code-font-size: 12.5px">

```rust
pub trait Camera {
    /// Bring the sensor out of standby and prepare it to capture.
    fn power_on(&mut self);

    /// Return the sensor to a low-power idle state.
    fn power_off(&mut self);

    /// Capture and discard warm-up frames so the sensor / on-chip filters
    /// settle.
    fn calibrate(&mut self);

    /// Receive a single frame as a ready-to-encode image.
    fn receive_frame(&mut self) -> Image;

    /// Capture a frame starting from the powered-off state and turn the camera back off.
    fn capture(&mut self) -> Image {
        self.power_on();
        self.calibrate();
        let image = self.receive_frame();
        self.power_off();
        image
    }
}
```

</div>

<div class="backup-caption"><b>Listing 2:</b> The <code>Camera</code> trait in the <code>beacon</code> crate.</div>

pub trait AudioChannel {
    /// The rate at which the hardware plays samples, in Hz.
    fn sample_rate(&self) -> u32;

    /// Output a single sample. May be buffered internally.
    fn transmit(&mut self, sample: i16) -> Result<(), AudioError>;

    /// Write all buffered samples out to the hardware.
    fn flush(&mut self) -> Result<(), AudioError>;
}
```

#[test]
fn shared_pair_colour_differences_average_both_rows() {
    let mut pixels = two_rows();
    let lines = lines_over(&mut pixels, ColorMode::YuvSharedPair);
    let top = YuvPixel::from(TOP_ROW[0]);
    let bottom = YuvPixel::from(BOTTOM_ROW[0]);

    let red_average = average(top.chroma_red(), bottom.chroma_red());
    let blue_average = average(top.chroma_blue(), bottom.chroma_blue());
    assert_eq!(lines.value(0, Channel::RY), red_average);
    assert_eq!(lines.value(0, Channel::BY), blue_average);
}
```

<div class="backup-code" style="--slidev-code-font-size: 12.5px">

```rust
#[test]
fn synthesizer_matches_pure_sine_wave() {
    let sample_rate: u32 = 48_000;
    let tones = [
        tone!(1200 Hz, 10 ms),
        tone!(1500 Hz, 10 ms),
        tone!(2300 Hz, 10 ms),
    ];

    let samples: Vec<i16> = Synthesizer::new(tones.into_iter(), sample_rate)
        .collect();
    let reference_samples = float_reference(&tones, sample_rate);

    let difference: Vec<u16> = samples
        .iter()
        .zip(&reference_samples)
        .map(|(sample, reference_sample)| sample.abs_diff(*reference_sample))
        .collect();
    let max_difference = *difference.iter().max().unwrap();
    let max_reference_sample = reference_samples
        .iter()
        .max()
        .unwrap()
        .abs() as u16;

    // should not deviate by more than 2%
    assert!(max_difference <= max_reference_sample / 50);
}
```

</div>

<div class="backup-caption"><b>Listing 8:</b> The <code>synthesizer_matches_pure_sine_wave()</code> unit test in <code>sstv</code> verifying the generated audio samples against a floating-point reference.</div>

#[test]
fn single_camera_captures_then_encodes_and_flushes_once() {
    let (camera, log) = FakeCamera::boxed();
    let mut audio = FakeAudio::new();

    transmit_sstv(&mut vec![Some(camera)], &mut audio).expect("transmission");

    assert_eq!(
        log.calls(),
        ["power_on", "calibrate", "receive_frame", "power_off"]
    );
    assert_eq!(audio.completed_transmissions(), 1);
    assert!(audio.samples > 0);
}
```

        "only the working camera transmits"
    );
}

        initialize_payload_link()

    let mut audio =
        initialize_audio_channel()
            .report_if_err(&link)
            .unwrap();

        initialize_rgb_camera()
            .report_if_err(&link)
            .ok()
            .map(boxed);
    let thermal_camera =
        initialize_thermal_camera()
            .report_if_err(&link)
            .ok()
            .map(boxed);

    link.send(Message::Available);
    idle(
        &mut link,
        vec![
            rgb_camera,
            thermal_camera,
        ],
        &mut audio,
    );
}
```

fn main() {
    initialize_esp32();
    let mut link =
        initialize_payload_link()
            .unwrap();

    let mut i2c =
        initialize_board()
            .report_if_err(&link)
            .unwrap();
    let mut audio =
        initialize_audio_channel(
            &mut i2c,
        )
        .report_if_err(&link)
        .unwrap();

    let rgb_camera =
        initialize_rgb_camera(i2c)
            .report_if_err(&link)
            .ok()
            .map(boxed);

    link.send(Message::Available);
    idle(
        &mut link,
        vec![rgb_camera],
        &mut audio,
    );
}
